answer_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
      LEFT JOIN contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
        ON sl.store_key = s.store_key
      WHERE
        s.is_online = FALSE
        AND s.close_date IS NULL
        AND s.country_code = (
          SELECT
            country_code
          FROM contoso_served.dim_country
          WHERE
            country_name = 'Hungary'
        )
        AND sl.order_key IS NULL
    )
    THEN 'yes'
    ELSE 'no'
  END AS answer
